kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
احسسن (form I)
# اُحْسُسْنَ (uḥsusna) /uħ.sus.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”)
# اِحْسِسْنَ (iḥsisna) /iħ.sis.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to be moved with compassion”)
# اِحْسَسْنَ (iḥsasna) /iħ.sas.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to feel, to perceive”)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
